description.value:
Duration constant

Reduce or ignore range penalties on your shots.

Increase the range increment of any firearm you wield by 50%, and reduce the range penalty for each increment beyond the first by 1.

cinderfall.incomplete: The range-increment increase is built above via mode:"multiply" value:1.5 (an exact-shape match to Ranger's real Far Shot, which doubles range increment the same unconditional way -- pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/ranger/level-4/far-shot.json), avoiding the unconfirmed base-range-formula guess the initial draft flagged as an open question. The separate "reduce the range penalty for each increment beyond the first by 1" clause is a different mechanism (the computed per-increment penalty itself, not the increment distance) and has no selector to alter that computed penalty directly -- that half stays unbuilt.
